name: quarto-chromium
description: Installs Chromium runtime for Quarto HTML/PDF rendering

postInstallCheck.command:
chromium_bin="$(command -v chromium || command -v chromium-browser || true)"
if [ -z "${chromium_bin}" ]; then
  echo "quarto-chromium: CHECK FAIL - no chromium/chromium-browser on PATH" >&2
  exit 1
fi
err_file="$(mktemp)"
out="$(timeout 60 "${chromium_bin}" --headless --disable-gpu --dump-dom about:blank 2>"${err_file}")" && rc=0 || rc=$?
if [ "${rc}" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "quarto-chromium: CHECK FAIL - headless chromium exited ${rc}" >&2
  cat "${err_file}" >&2
  rm -f "${err_file}"
  exit 1
fi
rm -f "${err_file}"
if [ -z "${out}" ]; then
  echo "quarto-chromium: CHECK FAIL - headless chromium produced no output" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "quarto-chromium: check OK (headless chromium rendered via ${chromium_bin})"
postInstallCheck.description: Functionally verify headless Chromium starts and renders (CI-safe shim + shared libraries), not just that the binary exists
